pages.text: Economics and Finance of Higher Education | NBER Skip to main content Economics and Finance of Higher Education October 15, 2027 — Cambridge, MA Share X LinkedIn Facebook Bluesky Threads Email Link The higher education sector is a key source of creativity, economic competitiveness, and resiliency of the US economy. It currently enrolls more than 18 million students, about three quarters of them in public institutions. The central role of higher education in a modern economy makes it important to understand both the economics and the financing of the sector. The financial model of higher education has been under stress for decades as costs rise and revenue growth proved elusive, but the challenges have become sharper in the last few years. Cutbacks in federal research funding, along with new taxes on the endowment returns of the wealthiest universities and restrictions on traditionally high-tuition foreign students, have created new financial tensions. To provide new insights on the financial aspects of the higher education sector, the National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), with support from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, will host a research conference in Cambridge on Friday, October 15, 2027. John Y. Campbell (Harvard University), Kaye Husbands Fealing (Georgia Tech), and James Poterba (MIT) will organize the conference. A diferencia del modelo lineal de «extraer-fabricar-desechar», que genera un gran desperdicio, la circularidad fomenta la producción y el consumo sostenibles, al tiempo que crea millones de puestos de trabajo. El primer informe de referencia sobre el empleo en la economía circular mundial, elaborado por la OIT, Circle Economy y el Grupo del Banco Mundial, estima que al menos entre 121 y 142 millones de personas trabajan en actividades total o parcialmente circulares. Estas actividades van desde los artesanos que reparan y reciclan productos hasta los recolectores de residuos y las empresas que adoptan modelos de negocio circulares. Sin embargo, muchos trabajadores de los segmentos informales se enfrentan a condiciones peligrosas y carecen de derechos básicos. Para garantizar un trabajo decente y socialmente justo para todos, la OIT colabora con los mandantes tripartitos y los socios clave para promover una transición justa y rica en empleo hacia la economía circular. El trabajo de cuidados implica actividades y relaciones que mantienen la calidad de vida, nutren las capacidades humanas, fomentan la agencia, la autonomía y la dignidad, y desarrollan las oportunidades y la resiliencia tanto de los cuidadores como de los receptores de cuidados. Satisface una serie de necesidades físicas, psicológicas, cognitivas, de salud mental y de desarrollo en todas las etapas de la vida, incluidos los niños, los jóvenes, los adultos, las personas mayores, las personas con discapacidad y los cuidadores. El trabajo de cuidados remunerado abarca diversas ocupaciones y sectores. Las entidades de la ESS aspiran a la viabilidad y la sostenibilidad a largo plazo y a la transición de la economía informal a la economía formal, y operan en todos los sectores de la economía. pages.description: Eddie James and Taine Basham are hungry for more after helping Wales make history against New Zealand, with Australia next up in Cardiff.
pages.text: Eddie James: Wales' win against New Zealand the stuff of dreams - BBC Sport Image source, Huw Evans Picture Agency Image caption, Centre Eddie James made his Wales debut against South Africa in 2024 By Chris Kirwan BBC Sport Wales Published 15 November 2026 Eddie James conducted his post-match media duties at Principality Stadium while clutching a souvenir match ball. Perhaps the one he dotted down for one of Wales' five tries in the historic 35-28 win against New Zealand , maybe the one he wrapped up with his long right arm in one of many telling defensive moments. The 24-year-old Scarlets centre has become a firm fixture in Steve Tandy's starting line-up because of his strong running and offloading threat. He crossed down the left wing early in the second half, yet it is one of his 25 tackles that is one of the moments to watch and rewatch. At 35-21, a try looked certain when Anton Lienert-Brown burst towards the line but James reached out, stopped the New Zealand centre a metre out and ensured there was no offload. The All Blacks would go over one more time but it was a moment to encapsulate Wales' defensive desire. "I honestly can't feel a thing," he said while still in his kit, almost an hour after the final whistle. "I haven't been able feel my feet for a long time now. It was an amazing performance defensively. "We're such a small nation and we pride ourselves a lot on our heart." pages.text: Eddie Rosario 2021 NLCS MVP Skip to Content ATLANTA -- Eddie Rosario ’s son, Lucas, bounded back and forth between the front edge of the podium and the spot where his father was standing a few feet away. Lucas wore a blue-and-red jacket over a blue-and-red T-shirt, and he clutched a pop-it toy in one hand. He looked around in awe as tens of thousands of Braves fans chanted his father’s name. Those fans had chanted early in Game 6 of the National League Championship Series on Saturday night at Truist Park, then again after Rosario was named series MVP. “ED-DIE! ED-DIE!” came the shouts, while father and son listened. Rosario held the trophy aloft, shaking it above his head. “That’s something you have to earn,” he said afterward. Rosario had earned it by being the most dynamic player of the NLCS: one of only five players to record 14 hits in a postseason series, one of only three qualified players to hit .560 or better in a series, one of only two to piece together multiple four-hit games, and so on and so forth until the statistics begin to blur. By the waning moments of Atlanta’s 4-2 victory in Game 6 , it was obvious that Rosario would be the MVP, becoming the eighth player to win that LCS honor following a midseason trade, joining the Astros' Justin Verlander (2017), the Indians' Andrew Miller ('16), the Giants' Marco Scutaro ('12), the Giants' Cody Ross ('10), the Yankees' David Justice ('00), the Braves' Mike Devereaux (1995) and the A's Rickey Henderson ('89). “We just couldn’t figure him out,” Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said. “We just didn’t have an answer for him.”

A new exhibition of her masterworks is traveling the country and reclaiming her place in American history. During her lifetime, Edmonia Lewis was America's most famous artists. Seen here, the biracial sculptor defied the odds and produced trailblazing work. Augustus Marshall, Courtesy Smithsonian National Museum of African American History and Culture By Katy Kelleher Published June 15, 2026 Part celebrity, part anomaly, sculptor Edmonia Lewis captivated mid-19 th -century audiences with her luminous, large-scale marble sculptures that appeared nearly lifelike in their carefully rendered detail. For wealthy Americans on the Grand Tour, a stop at her studio was practically necessary. But visitors weren’t just there to follow in the footsteps of Pope Pius IX and President Ulysses S. Grant, both admirers of Lewis, they were there to obtain proof. They wanted to see with their own eyes that Lewis, a petite biracial woman, could render life from stone. For some, it beggared belief that her hands could have coaxed forth vivid expressions from blocks of Carrara marble. While she was able to delegate some of the brute work of carving to assistants, Lewis made a point of ensuring that the public saw her with a chisel in hand, an unusual choice for sculptors of the era. Even in the prime of her storied career, Lewis still needed to prove herself, to justify her talent

It is based on the local application of basic agroecological principles. FAO’s framework on agroecology is based on the following elements: diversity, co-creation and sharing of knowledge, synergies, efficiency, recycling, resilience, human and social values, culture and food traditions, responsible governance, circular and solidarity economy. The choice of management practices and technologies to achieve agroecology or to move towards an agroecological transition is always location specific, shaped by a given social-ecological context. The science of agroecology explicitly recognises the value of bottom-up participatory research and knowledge and promotes: (i) bridging formal and informal innovation processes; (ii) combining local knowledge systems and expertise with scientific knowledge; (iii) acknowledging and respecting farmers and food provisioners as owners of knowledge and co-researchers and innovators. Educators can use these historical documents to teach about representative democracy, how Congress works, and the important role Congress has played throughout American history. Exhibitions The Center for Legislative Archives has partnered with the U.S. Capitol Visitor Center (CVC) since its opening in 2008 to display historic documents from the U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and the National Archives. The Center works closely with the CVC to curate rotating exhibits featuring landmark legislation and other treasures from the records of Congress. The Exhibition Hall at the CVC features the only exhibit in the country dedicated to telling the story of Congress and the history of the Capitol. New rotations in the Exhibition Hall are installed twice a year, in March and September. Top ×

pages.text: Edvard Munch | Tate Modern Step into the soulful world of mesmerising Munch Edvard Munch once described his famous painting series The Frieze of Life as ‘impressions from the life of the soul’. Through powerful images, Munch explored feelings we all recognise - love, loss, and loneliness in a changing world. This compelling new exhibition, organised in collaboration with the MUNCH museum, looks at Munch’s ‘soul paintings’ through the lens of cinema and visual storytelling. With unique input from contemporary filmmakers and academics, the exhibition will bring unprecedented insight into his radical tales of identity and desire. The exhibition includes key works from The Frieze of Life , alongside large-scale paintings, prints, photographs, Munch’s experimental film and rare archival material. By exploring universal themes of passion, pain, and inner turmoil, the show reveals why Munch’s work still feels so relevant in an era shaped by online sharing, self-expression and emotional honesty. Exhibition organised by Tate Modern in collaboration with MUNCH. Edvard Munch is presented in the Eyal Ofer Galleries. Supported by Tate Members. pages.text: Edwin Díaz, Aroldis Chapman win 2025 Reliever of the Year Awards Skip to Content It’s not much of a debate who the best closers in the game were during the 2025 season. Now, Aroldis Chapman and Edwin Díaz have the hardware to prove it. The two hurlers received the Reliever of the Year Award in their respective leagues at the MLB Awards presented by MGM Rewards in Las Vegas on Thursday. All-time Reliever of the Year Award winners Chapman won Mariano Rivera American League Reliever of the Year honors for the second time in his career, having previously won the award with the Yankees in 2019. Meanwhile, Díaz earned Trevor Hoffman National League Reliever of the Year honors for the second time, and his third Reliever of the Year Award overall. He previously won the AL honor with the Mariners in 2018 before winning his first in the NL with the Mets in 2022. Chapman turned back the clock in his age-37 season with the Red Sox, making his eighth All-Star team. The southpaw led all qualified relievers with a 1.17 ERA and 0.70 WHIP in 61 1/3 innings. pages.text: Edwin Díaz, Emmanuel Clase win 2022 Relievers of the Year Award Skip to Content Closers Edwin Díaz of the Mets and Emmanuel Clase of the Guardians went about their jobs a bit differently in 2022. Díaz racked up strikeouts at a record rate. Clase pounded the strike zone to get quick outs. But one thing they had in common -- other than routinely hitting triple digits on the radar gun -- was their late-game dominance. • All-time Reliever of the Year winners Major League Baseball’s highest relief honors were bestowed upon Díaz and Clase on Tuesday. Díaz is the 2022 recipient of the Trevor Hoffman National League Reliever of the Year Award, and Clase is the winner of the Mariano Rivera American League Reliever of the Year Award. Díaz, who won the AL version of the award in 2018 with the Mariners, joins Craig Kimbrel as the only players to win the Reliever of the Year Award in each league. The awards have been presented since 2014, when they replaced MLB’s “Delivery Man of the Year Award,” which had been presented to one winner across MLB from 2005-13. Clase, meanwhile, is a first-time recipient, though it’s hardly the first honor he’s received this season. The 24-year-old righty was named an All-Star for the first time earlier this year, and it was announced on Monday that he was one of two relievers -- along with Díaz -- voted to the All-MLB First Team. Clase posted a 1.36 ERA this season and led the Majors with 42 saves. Not all fish, shellfish, or the insects that they eat can tolerate the same amount of acid. An ecosystem is a community of plants, animals and other organisms along with their environment including the air, water and soil. Everything in an ecosystem is connected. If something harms one part of an ecosystem – one species of plant or animal, the soil or the water – it can have an impact on everything else. Effects of Acid Rain on Fish and Wildlife The ecological effects of acid rain are most clearly seen in aquatic environments, such as streams, lakes, and marshes where it can be harmful to fish and other wildlife. As it flows through the soil, acidic rain water can leach aluminum from soil clay particles and then flow into streams and lakes. Thanh toán hầu hết các loại thuế cá nhân thông qua Tài khoản trực tuyến của bạn. Đối với các loại hình thanh toán ít phổ biến hơn, Direct Pay hiện chấp nhận thanh toán trên các mẫu đơn bổ sung . Người dùng EFTPS hiện tại vẫn có thể sử dụng EFTPS vào lúc này. EFTPS (tiếng Anh) là một hệ thống miễn phí do Bộ Tài chính Hoa Kỳ cung cấp để trả tiền thuế liên bang của bạn. EFTPS cung cấp Sự bảo mật mà bạn có thể tin cậy Việc sử dụng Mã số thuế ( EIN hoặc SSN ), Mã số cá nhân (PIN) và Mật khẩu Internet, cùng với trình duyệt Internet an toàn, sẽ tăng tính bảo mật cho bạn. Sự thuận tiện nằm trong tầm tay của bạn Lên lịch thanh toán trước tối đa 365 ngày. Thanh toán tiền thuế của bạn từ nhà hoặc văn phòng, 24/7. Trả thuế thu nhập, thuế việc làm, thuế ước tính và thuế gián thu liên bang. Dễ dàng thay đổi hoặc hủy bỏ các khoản thanh toán theo lịch. Theo dõi việc thanh toán của bạn bằng các thông báo qua email. pages.description: Use the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS) to pay your taxes. Pay via a secure site or by phone using the EFTPS Voice Response System.

Pay most individual taxes through your Online Account . For less common payment types, Direct Pay now accepts payments on additional forms . Current EFTPS users can still use EFTPS for now. As of Nov. 12, 2026, EFTPS is no longer available for individuals to make payments. If you previously scheduled a payment through EFTPS.gov, you can still sign in to cancel the payment up to two business days before the scheduled payment date. EFTPS is a free system offered by the U.S. Department of Treasury to pay your federal taxes. EFTPS offers Security you can count on The use of your Taxpayer Identification Number (EIN or SSN), Personal Identification Number (PIN) and Internet Password, along with a secure Internet browser, increases your security. pages.description: 전자식 연방세 납부 시스템(EFTPS)은 미국 재무부에서 납세자의 연방 세금 납부를 위해 무료로 제공하는 시스템입니다. EFTPS에 대한 설명과 사용방법에 대해 알아보십시오.
pages.text: EFTPS：전자 연방세 납부 시스템 | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content EFTPS：전자 연방세 납부 시스템 English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In 지불 은행 계좌 직불 또는 신용카드 귀하의 온라인 계정 사업세 납부 (EFTPS) 지불 계획 세금 채무 도움말 과태료 이자 세금 원천징수 해외 전자 납부 사용자 수수료 (영어) ​ 개인 납세자 신규 등록 불가 개인 납세자는 더 이상 새 EFTPS 계정을 생성할 수 없습니다. 대부분의 개인 세금은 온라인 계정 을 통해 납부하십시오. 일반적이지 않은 납부 유형의 경우 이제 Direct Pay 에서 추가 서식 에 대한 납부를 받습니다. 현재 EFTPS 사용자는 당분간 여전히 EFTPS를 사용할 수 있습니다 EFTPS (영어) 는 미국 재무부에서 납세자의 연방 세금 납부를 위해 제공하는 무료 시스템입니다. EFTPS 는 다음을 제공합니다: 신뢰할 수 있는 보안 안전한 인터넷 브라우저에서 납세자 식별 번호 ( EIN 또는 SSN ), 개인 식별 번호 ( PIN ) 및 인터넷 암호, 그리고 안전한 인터넷 브라우저를 병용하여 보안이 강화됩니다. 언제든 이용 가능한 편리성 납부일을 365일 까지 미리 예약할 수 있습니다. 집이나 사무실에서 언제든지 세금을 납부할 수 있습니다. 귀하의 소득, 고용, 연방세 중간예납 및 연방 특별 소비세를 납부할 수 있습니다. 예약된 세금 납부를 쉽게 변경하거나 취소할 수 있습니다. 이메일 알림으로 납부 상황을 추적할 수 있습니다. 지난 15개월 동안의 납부 내역을 확인할 수 있습니다. 고객 서비스 안내원으로부터 납부 또는 질문에 대한 도움을 받을 수 있습니다. 신뢰할 수 있는 정확성 귀하의 납부에 대한 즉각적 확인 내역과 귀하의 은행 명세서를 검토하여 납부 사실을 확인할 수 있습니다. 다수의 고객의 세금 납부를 할 수 있는 수용력 세무 전문가는, 단일 로그인으로 다수 고객의 세금을 납부할 수 있습니다. 무료 Batch Provider Software (일괄처리 제공자 소프트웨어)를 다운로드하십시오(영어) . 간행물 5301, 전자 연방 세금 납부 시스템 – 일괄처리 제공자 소프트웨어 사용자 매뉴얼(영어) PDF EFTPS 등록 방법 신규 EFTPS 등록은 업무일수로 최대 5일이 소요됩니다. EFTPS 에서 가입(영어) 하거나 EFTPS 고객 서비스에 가입 양식을 요청하십시오: 800-555-4477 877-333-8292 (연방 기관) 800-733-4829 (청각 장애인을 위한 TDD 전화) 800-244-4829 (스페인어) EFTPS 사용 시 추가 이점 EFTPS 음성 응답 시스템 ( 800-555-3453 )으로도 납부할 수 있습니다. 자주 묻는 질문(영어) 을 이용하여 즉각적인 정보 이용이 가능합니다. 회원가입 이후 사용방법(영어) 기능을 사용할 수 있습니다(가입자에게만 해당). pages.text: Egyptian Bead Dress | National Geographic HISTORY & CULTURE This Ancient Egyptian Fashion Enchanted a Pharaoh Fragments of a 4,500 year-old dress were stored in a museum’s basement for decades until one researcher pieced it back together, looking for answers about the mysterious relic. Millicent Jick's reconstructed net dress, of blue and green faience beads; broad collar with faience beads and gold pendants. 4th dynasty. Museum of Fine Arts, Boston SCALA, FLORENCE By Cathy Newman Published August 18, 2026 More than 4,500 years old, the Egyptian bead net dress at the Museum of Fine Arts (MFA), Boston, is the first complete example of its kind. The better part of a century after its discovery, it was meticulously reconstructed over a period of three years. The dress belonged to a female contemporary of Pharaoh Khufu (ca 2500 B.C.), builder of the Great Pyramid. The beads were found scattered over and around her mummified body, which had been lying inside a limestone sarcophagus in an undisturbed tomb beneath the famous Giza Plateau. As the sarcophagus was unmarked, the woman’s identity remains shrouded in mystery, but her burial on the Giza Plateau, the necropolis of kings, speaks to her prominence. Perhaps she was the wife of an upper-level bureaucrat, speculates Larry Berman, the MFA’s senior curator of Ancient Egyptian, Nubian, and Near Eastern art. In any case, she must certainly have been well connected to be buried there. A person’s residence, temporal or eternal— then as now— was a clear and unmistakable measure of status. Peter Horree, Alamy By Taylor Mitchell Brown Published August 25, 2026 The Beautiful Festival of the Valley was an annual celebration in ancient Egypt that connected the royal and wealthy dead with the gods. To initiate the splendid occasion, large crowds of priests gathered outside the temple of Karnak in Thebes. Then they collected statues of the ancient Egyptian deities associated with the temple: Amun, Mut, and Khonsu. Afterward, the revelers ferried the statues across the Nile to bless important tombs and temples. As part of the festivities, the divine effigies were enshrined within wooden sailing vessels called barques and bedecked with flowers, gold, and precious stones of turquoise, carnelian, and lapis lazuli. As the procession marched forward, priests burned incense while musicians played instruments and danced. Leading the way were women known as “chantresses” who sang and shook ornate shakers.
